latest_events.title: AES: how jihadists learned to strike with drones
latest_events.summary: JNIM, a jihadist group linked to Al-Qaeda, claimed responsibility for an ambush on 28 September 2026 against a convoy of the Malian army and the Russian Africa Corps, near Niono, in central Mali. Drone fire opened the attack before the ground assault, and at least four Russians were killed according to local sources . This is clearly an evolution that the armies of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), which brings together Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, have not been able to stop: in three years, armed groups in the region have gone from simple reconnaissance drones to strike weapons.

latest_events.title: Segou: About thirty JNIM and Fla terrorists neutralized by the FAMa and the Africa Corps
latest_events.summary: Ségou: About thirty JNIM and Fla terrorists neutralized by the FAMa and the Africa Corps A joint military operation led by the Africa Corps of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation and the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) resulted, this Sunday, in the destruction of a large terrorist group in the Ségou region According to information relayed by the Africa Corps, the engagement targeted a coalition of fighters affiliated with the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM).

latest_events.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: Surgical strikes by the FAMa, several terrorist hideouts wiped out in the centre of the country By a statement issued on Tuesday, 29 September, the General Staff of the Armed Forces confirmed the continuation of the "Dougoukoloko" operation aimed at securing the territory. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted two rounds of targeted strikes on 27 and 28 September 2026 On Sunday, September 27, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 13 km east of the city of Niono, a point of entrenchment of armed terrorist groups.
